questions.question: 【고정 전치사 구문 드릴】 올바른 표현을 모두 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
PTE 초빈출 고정 구문 전체:
• in terms of
• as a result of
• in response to
• on the basis of
• in accordance with ← with!
• with regard to
• in relation to
• in addition to
• in comparison with ← with!
• in favour of
• in spite of
• in contrast to
• in place of
• in search of
questions.memo: 고정 전치사 구문 총정리 드릴

questions.question: 【종합 복습 1】 IN과 ON — 올바른 표현을 모두 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
IN 그룹: engage / participate / result / specialize / succeed / believe / involve
ON 그룹: focus / depend / concentrate / rely / base / insist / reflect / comment

헷갈릴 때: '참여·포함' → IN / '방향·근거' → ON
questions.memo: IN vs ON 종합 복습

questions.question: 【종합 복습 2】 TO와 WITH — 올바른 표현을 모두 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
TO 그룹: contribute / lead / refer / belong / respond / adapt / relate / attribute
WITH 그룹: associate / deal / cope / compare / agree / connect / collaborate / contrast

헷갈릴 때: '방향·연결' → TO / '관계·협력' → WITH
questions.memo: TO vs WITH 종합 복습

questions.question: 【종합 복습 3】 혼동하기 쉬운 고정 구문 — 올바른 것을 모두 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
⚠️ 자주 틀리는 것:
❌ in accordance TO → ✅ in accordance WITH
❌ in comparison TO → ✅ in comparison WITH
❌ in despite of → ✅ in spite of
❌ despite of → ✅ despite (of 없음!)

기억법: accordance / comparison 뒤에는 WITH!
questions.memo: 고정 구문 종합 복습 — 자주 틀리는 것

questions.question: 【종합 복습 4】 FOR과 OF — 올바른 표현을 모두 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
FOR 그룹 (형용사): responsible / known / famous / suitable / necessary / prepared / eligible / beneficial
OF 그룹 (명사): part / effect / result / cause / source / lack / form / type

헷갈릴 때: 형용사 뒤 → FOR / 명사 뒤 → OF
questions.memo: FOR vs OF 종합 복습

questions.question: 【최종 보스 드릴】 전 전치사 혼합 — 틀린 표현을 찾아 올바른 것만 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
틀린 표현 정정:
❌ responsible OF → ✅ responsible FOR
❌ part FOR → ✅ part OF
❌ in terms WITH → ✅ in terms OF

전 전치사 그룹 최종 정리:
IN: engage/participate/result/specialize/succeed/believe
ON: focus/depend/rely/base/insist/comment
TO: contribute/lead/adapt/respond/belong/attribute
WITH: associate/deal/cope/compare/agree/collaborate
FOR: responsible/known/suitable/necessary/beneficial
OF: part/effect/cause/source/lack/form
BETWEEN: relationship/difference/balance/connection
ABOUT: concerned/worried/informed/talk/think
AT: good/aim/look/arrive
questions.memo: 전 전치사 최종 종합 드릴
